en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard composed of multiple small photographs of waterfalls arranged decoratively around stylized floral graphics. Large ornate script text across the center reads "Jämtländska Vattenfall." Each photograph is captioned with the individual waterfall's name, and there is additional decorative text indicating the year and publisher/photographer. The overall layout is like an illustrated advertising or touristic card promoting the waterfalls of Jämtland.
